svg.text: Q6: exact ties: r1 + r2 = w (2 and 2 on 4) and r = w (4 on 4)
an exact tie is not a special case of the rule: the arcs are tangent, and the result is a perfect semicircle or quarter
A. r1 + r2 = w: tangent arcs (CHOSEN)
the top is two quarter circles, tangent at the
B. r = w: tangent to both faces (CHOSEN)
the arc ends on the far edge, tangent to the top
C. refuse ties, build ties of a hair either side
2.00000001 does not. A tie is not noise.
